scripts.build:vercel: node scripts/verificar-ambiente-producao.mjs && npm run build -w @lanona/web -- --configuration production
scripts.test:tudo: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci -w @lanona/web && npm run db:test && npm run e2e
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --local > packages/shared/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/shared/src/database.types.ts
scripts.db:types:remote: supabase gen types typescript --remote > packages/shared/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/shared/src/database.types.ts
